response.description:
The Austria East region is now generally available
to Azure Red Hat OpenShift customers and partners. The region
includes three availability zones, supporting resilient and scalable
operations. Why it matters: 
 In-country data residency: Data stored in
     Austria East remains within Austria, helping organizations meet
     local and EU regulatory requirements such as GDPR.   
 Lower latency: Local
     infrastructure reduces latency for applications serving users in Austria
     and nearby regions.   
 Supports regulated
     workloads: Enables public sector and regulated industries to adopt
     cloud with greater control over data location  Getting started: Customers can deploy
Azure Red Hat OpenShift resources in Austria East via the Azure
portal, CLI, or ARM templates.  Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now available in Austria East
